# A sortable dashboard: KPI tiles reorder by drag and pop into a window

## Context

#21140's target takes Dashboard & Docking from one card to five. Four are on `dev` `78013b10fc` (the choreography, the operations desk, the perspectives, the pop-out). The fifth, the one new demonstration, is missing: a sortable dashboard. No folder and no leaf exist for it.

## The Problem

The question the band named for it ([its rows](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6980130976)): "Can users rearrange a dashboard and pull a tile onto a second screen?" The four cards show docking. None shows the plain case a buyer asks first: tiles in a grid that I can reorder, and one of them on my second monitor.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/dashboard/Container.mjs` claims both: items reorder by drag, and an item dragged out becomes its own window and returns when dragged back.
- The drag needs the main-thread addon `src/main/addon/DragDrop.mjs`; the band's row says "the DragDrop main-thread addon is part of the leaf".
- `examples/dashboard/base` is the fixture of two e2e specs and stays untouched; the new example gets its own folder.

## The Fix

One new example in its own folder: a small operations or sales dashboard of six to eight KPI tiles (a number with a trend, a sparkline, a short list). Tiles reorder by drag. A tile dragged out of the window becomes its own window with its content live, and returns to its slot when dragged back. One line on the first frame says what to try. The drive of both behaviours on `dev` is the first step; a defect it finds is fixed here if it is small, else it gets its own ticket and this one names it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Tiles reorder by drag, and the new order holds after the drop.
- [ ] A tile dragged out opens as its own window with live content; dragged back, it returns to the dashboard.
- [ ] One line on the first frame names both actions.
- [ ] No console error, at 1440×900; at 390×844 the tiles stack and reorder, and the pop-out is offered only where a window can open.
- [ ] A record in Dashboard & Docking, cross-listed in Drag & Drop and Multi-Window, with a cover from its first frame (through `neomjs/pages`).
- [ ] The look: the first frame, a frame mid-drag and a frame with one tile in its own window, Neo Dark, on the pull request, read cold by the reviewer's seat.

**Publication (added 22 Nov, the same for every leaf of this wave).** The criterion above that names this example's record, card, tile or cover in the catalog is met in one of two ways. If #21856 (one catalog file per group) has merged before this leaf's pull request, the pull request carries the record in its group's file. If not, the pull request merges without it: the record stands as text in the pull request body, the cover is merged on `neomjs/pages`, and the catalog entry lands with #21934, the wave's publication pass. Either way this leaf closes with its example.

## Out of Scope

Docking (the other four cards). A change to `examples/dashboard/base`.

## Avoided Traps

- **Empty tiles.** "Widget 1" to "Widget 6" would repeat what the dock example was renewed away from; each tile shows content worth moving.
